title: OmniGround: A Comprehensive Spatio-Temporal Grounding Benchmark for Real-World Complex Scenarios

problems.name: Dataset, Benchmark, and Evaluation Mismatch
problems.evidence_sentence: We attribute this to limited benchmark scope, causing models to exhibit category bias, oversimplified reasoning, and poor linguistic robustness.To address these limitations, we introduce OmniGround, a comprehensive benchmark with 3,475 videos spanning 81 categories and complex real-world queries.

problems.name: Spatio-Temporal and Object/Event-Level Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: OmniGround: A Comprehensive Spatio-Temporal Grounding Benchmark for Real-World Complex Scenarios Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (STVG) aims to localize target objects in videos based on natural language descriptions.

problems.name: LLM Temporal Reasoning and Time Output Instability
problems.evidence_sentence: With the rapid development of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) [7, 9, 36, 41], the task has greatly benefited from MLLMs’ enhanced cross-modal semantic understanding and structured spatial reasoning, substantially outperforming traditional lightweight approaches [5, 14, 18, 37].

methods.evidence_sentence: Motivated by these, we propose PG-TAF, a training-free two-stage framework decomposing STVG into high-level temporal grounding and fine-grained spatio-temporal propagation.
